title: Verb + preposition 4 of/for/from/on
subtitle: accuse of, pay for, blame for/on, suffer from, depend on

head: Предлог
Глаголы
Пример
rows: accuse / suspect sb of; approve / disapprove of; die of (from); consist of
pay (sb) for; thank / forgive sb for; apologise (to sb) for; blame sb for
suffer from; protect sb/sth from; die from
depend on, rely on; live on; congratulate / compliment sb on; blame sth on sb

theory.text: Pay for — заплатить за покупку или услугу: pay for the tickets. Но pay the bill / the rent / a fine / tax — без предлога.

items: blame somebody for something: They blamed me for the mistake.
blame something on somebody: They blamed the mistake on me.
somebody is to blame for: Who is to blame for this?

theory.text: Depend с вопросительными словами можно без on: It depends how much it costs. = It depends on how much it costs.
«Зависит от» — depends on, не depends from. «Заплатить за обед» — pay for lunch, а не pay lunch. «Поздравить с» — congratulate on, не congratulate with.
